name: etl-pipeline
description: Extract CSV data, clean and enrich in parallel, validate against schema, then load to destination

agents.name: csv-extractor
agents.prompt: Read and parse the source CSV file into structured rows

agents.name: data-cleaner
agents.prompt: Normalize values, remove duplicates, and fix formatting issues

agents.name: data-enricher
agents.prompt: Add computed fields: full_name, days_since_signup, email_domain

agents.name: schema-validator
agents.prompt: Validate all rows against the expected output schema

agents.name: db-loader
agents.prompt: Write validated records to the destination
